summary: An 82 mm die-cast radio-controlled buggy at 1:64 — orange body, a low wedge nose, an open cockpit with a roll… joints steer_l_l, spin_front_l_l, steer_l_r, spin_front_l_r, spin_rear_l_l, spin_rear_l_r.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.toy_rc_bolt or place "prefab": "toy_rc_bolt" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
